label: Every word on the Ops & chips screen

params.name: lede
params.default: Every decision this portal makes is a chip built from ops. Open one to see its knobs, logic and tests, try it on a scenario, and send a change through draft, review and live. Nothing goes live with a problem or a failing test.

params.name: server_refused
params.default: The server refused that. Reload the page and try again.

params.name: leave_body
params.default: You changed this and did not save it. Leaving throws those changes away.

params.name: find_chips
params.default: Find a chip: id, name or set

params.name: find_ops
params.default: Find an op: name or what it does

params.name: pick_title
params.default: Pick a chip, an op or a scenario

params.name: pick_line
params.default: Its knobs, logic, tests and who uses it open here. Chips are grouped by set; the search finds any of them by id, name or set.

params.name: ro_framework
params.default: Framework chip — only the owner changes it. You can read it and try it.

params.name: ro_other_draft
params.default: This draft is {who}'s. You can read it and try it; they or an editor change it.

params.name: ro_chip
params.default: You can read this chip and try it, but not change it.

params.name: reaches
params.default: A published change reaches everything that uses this chip: {list}. See Used by.

params.name: draft_saved
params.default: Draft saved. Nobody else sees it until it is published.

params.name: ready_toast
params.default: Ready to publish: no problems, and every test passes.

params.name: not_ready_toast
params.default: Not ready yet — the check lists what to fix.

params.name: sent_review
params.default: Sent for review. An editor publishes it or sends it back with a note.

params.name: not_published
params.default: Not published: fix the problems and failing tests first. The check shows what is wrong.

params.name: return_lede
params.default: Say what to change. The author sees this note on the draft and can submit it again.

params.name: return_ph
params.default: e.g. Test 2 expects the wrong value

params.name: note_first
params.default: Write a note first — the author needs to know what to change.

params.name: discard_body
params.default: The draft of {id} is thrown away.

params.name: discard_body_dirty
params.default: The draft of {id} and your unsaved changes are thrown away.

params.name: discard_live
params.default: The live version stays as it is.

params.name: discard_never
params.default: It was never published, so the chip goes with it.

params.name: off_first_body
params.default: {id} is used by live chips or rules. Switch them off, or change them to stop using it, first.

params.name: off_body
params.default: {id} stops answering until it is switched back on. Nothing live uses it. History keeps a copy.

params.name: delete_body
params.default: {id} is removed from this portal. A copy stays in its history on the server.

params.name: copy_lede
params.default: The new draft starts with everything you see here — knobs, logic and tests, including changes you have not saved. The original is not touched.

params.name: nothing_changed
params.default: Nothing changed since the last save

params.name: delete_used_tip
params.default: Other chips or rules use it — change them first

params.name: label_ph
params.default: What this chip answers, in plain words

params.name: desc_ph
params.default: What it decides and how — for the next person who reads it

params.name: set_hint
params.default: The group it files under. Pick an existing one when it fits.

params.name: who_hint
params.default: Only the owner makes a framework chip.

params.name: aliases_label
params.default: Other names — search finds it by these

params.name: desc_hint
params.default: Plain words. People read this beside every decision the chip makes.

params.name: try_aria
params.default: Scenario to try the logic on

params.name: pred_value_warn
params.default: This chip answers yes or no, but its logic gives a value. Pick a Test or a Chip at the top of the logic.

params.name: rechecked
params.default: Checked again on its own a moment after every change, with your unsaved edits.

params.name: uses_none
params.default: No other chip or op yet.

params.name: used_none
params.default: Nothing uses it — a change here reaches no other chip or rule.

params.name: restore_body
params.default: It comes back as a draft and is checked again before it can go live.

params.name: restore_replaces
params.default: It replaces the draft that is there now.

params.name: restore_unsaved
params.default: Your unsaved changes are thrown away.

params.name: restored
params.default: Version {v} is back as a draft.

params.name: extra_lede
params.default: Anything else this chip carries, such as notes or sources. Every field of the chip is shown somewhere on this page.

params.name: extra_clash
params.default: {names} has its own place above, so it was not added here.

params.name: about_hint
params.default: name, set, what it answers, description

params.name: knobs_hint
params.default: the numbers and words a person may change

params.name: logic_hint
params.default: how the answer is built from ops and other chips

params.name: check_hint
params.default: problems and test results, as it would be published

params.name: used_hint
params.default: what it uses and what uses it

params.name: ver_diff
params.default: Different from what is open in the editor: {fields}.

params.name: ver_same
params.default: The same as what is open in the editor.

params.name: id_rule
params.default: Lower-case letters, digits and _, with a dot between the set and the name. It cannot change later.

params.name: answers_ph
params.default: e.g. The video is longer than the limit

params.name: bad_id
params.default: That id is not allowed. Use set.name: lower-case letters, digits and _, for example video.too_long.

params.name: id_exists
params.default: A chip with that id already exists. Pick another id.

params.name: new_lede
params.default: A chip is one named decision. It starts as your draft: add its knobs, logic and tests, then submit it for review.

params.name: draft_made_private
params.default: Draft {id} made. Nobody else sees it until it is published.

params.name: no_op_line
params.default: It may have been removed from the code.

params.name: op_off_tip
params.default: Switched off — no new chip may use it

params.name: make_from_op
params.default: Make a chip from this op

params.name: op_meta_one
params.default: An op: a building block written in Python. {n} live chip uses it.

params.name: op_meta_many
params.default: An op: a building block written in Python. {n} live chips use it.

params.name: op_rewrite
params.default: An op cannot be rewritten from a screen. For a new behaviour, make a chip from ops: its knobs, logic and tests are all editable here, and it goes through review like any other chip.

params.name: op_now_off
params.default: {name} is switched off. No new chip may use it.

params.name: op_off_body_one
params.default: {n} live chip uses it. They keep answering, but none of them can be published again while it uses a switched-off op, and no new chip may use it.

params.name: op_off_body_many
params.default: {n} live chips use it. They keep answering, but none of them can be published again while it uses a switched-off op, and no new chip may use it.

params.name: op_off_note
params.default: Switched off: {note} No new chip may use it.

params.name: op_off_plain
params.default: Switched off. No new chip may use it.

params.name: op_on_owner
params.default: On. Only the owner can switch an op off.

params.name: op_note_ph
params.default: Why — people see this beside the op

params.name: op_scan_lede_one
params.default: The server counts {n} live chip. "Find them" also looks in drafts and rules.

params.name: op_scan_lede_many
params.default: The server counts {n} live chips. "Find them" also looks in drafts and rules.

params.name: from_op_lede
params.default: A new draft that runs {op}, with each thing it takes as a knob. Give the knobs their types and defaults, add tests, then submit it.

params.name: scan_none
params.default: Nothing uses it: no live chip, draft or rule.

params.name: rules_blocked
params.default: Rules are not listed: you cannot open the Rule Chip Builder.

params.name: scen_bad_id
params.default: The id is lower-case letters, digits and _, 3 to 60 long, starting with a letter.

params.name: scen_exists
params.default: A scenario with that id exists. Pick another id.

params.name: scen_pick_subject
params.default: Pick what the scenario is about.

params.name: scen_saved
params.default: Scenario saved. Tests and Try can use it now.

params.name: scen_delete_body
params.default: {id} is removed. Tests that name it stop finding its facts. If the portal ships a scenario with the same id, that one comes back.

params.name: scen_label_ph
params.default: What situation this is, e.g. A sign-up from a school address

params.name: scen_id_hint
params.default: Lower-case letters, digits and _. It cannot change later.

params.name: pick_subject_first
params.default: Pick what the scenario is about first — that says which facts it has.

params.name: not_given
params.default: Not given: unknown in a test, and unknown never passes.

params.name: more_facts_lede
params.default: Facts the subject does not list, for a chip that reads a value of its own.

params.name: ro_scen
params.default: You can read this scenario, but not change it.

params.name: shipped_note
params.default: Ships with the portal. Saving keeps your version in this portal's data, and yours is used from then on.

params.name: scen_meta_new
params.default: A named set of facts that Try and the tests run on.

params.name: scen_used_lede
params.default: Chips and rules whose tests run on this scenario. Change it and their tests may change too.
